name: Mara
bio: Delivered on a bicycle before the Silence. Knows every alley in the neighborhood.

habits.text: Counts things when she's anxious: bolts, steps, cans.
Sleeps with her boots on, just in case.
Hums her father's harmonica tunes when she thinks nobody's listening.
Saves you the last cracker. Every time.

lines: Went out the back way last night. Brought these. And I played a little, after, on the roof.
You know the alley behind the bakery? Nobody does. I do. Here.
thanks.text: {name} slipped out by her own ways and came back with a bag

name: Irene
bio: Lab technician. Writes everything down in a notebook she won't show anyone.

habits.text: Labels everything. The jars. The shelves. Once, someone else's mug.
Checks the door lock three times before sleeping.
Talks to the static when she thinks she's alone.
Leaves you tea on the console without saying anything.

lines: I catalogued the stores. Three boxes of components were labelled as scrap. Also, I wrote a procedure. Everyone has read it.
I've written up how the workshop should be run. Step by step. You'll find it saves time.
thanks.text: {name} went through the stores with her notebook
